# binder

> Zero-dependency HTTP request binding for Go, v1.1.0. Maps path parameters, query strings, JSON and form bodies, cookies and headers onto a struct using struct tags. Binding only — no validation framework, no router, no logging.

Module: `uradical.io/go/binder` · Source: https://github.com/uRadical/binder · License: MIT · Requires Go 1.27.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://binder.dev/docs/): Documentation for binder 1.1.0, a zero-dependency Go library that binds HTTP request data — path, query, body, multipart forms, cookies and headers — onto a struct using struct tags.
- [Install & quick start](https://binder.dev/docs/install.html): Add uradical.io/go/binder to a Go 1.27 module and bind your first handler — path parameter, query string and JSON body in one call.
- [Binding sources](https://binder.dev/docs/sources.html): The six binder struct tags — path, query, body, json, cookie and header — what each reads from the request, how repeated values fill slices, and which tag wins when a field carries more than one.
- [Types & conversion](https://binder.dev/docs/types.html): Which Go types binder can fill — strings, numbers, bools, slices, pointers, nested structs — how values are converted from each source, and how to bind a type of your own with encoding.TextUnmarshaler.
- [Options](https://binder.dev/docs/options.html): binder's tag options — required and omitempty — and per-call configuration through BindOptions, including MaxBodySize and DisallowUnknownFields.
- [Error handling](https://binder.dev/docs/errors.html): How binder reports failures — the BindError type naming field, source and key, the five sentinel errors, and which HTTP status each one deserves.
- [Validation](https://binder.dev/docs/validation.html): binder's Validator interface — implement Validate() error on a request type and it runs as part of binding — and why the library has no validation tags of its own.
- [API reference](https://binder.dev/docs/api.html): Every exported identifier in uradical.io/go/binder — Bind, BindWithOptions, BindStruct, BindOptions, BindError, Validator, MaxBodySize and the five sentinel errors.
- [Performance](https://binder.dev/docs/performance.html): Measured cost of a binder call — nanoseconds and allocations per bind for each source — how the benchmarks were taken, and how to reproduce them.
- [Comparison](https://binder.dev/docs/comparison.html): binder measured against Echo, Gin, gorilla/schema and hand-written stdlib code — the method, the version of each library, and what each was asked to do.
- [Compatibility](https://binder.dev/docs/compatibility.html): What binder promises across a major version — the exported functions, types, sentinels and struct tags — what it explicitly does not promise, and the Go version support policy.
